venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: Steady Thursday at CC ATL with sales and guest flow building through the night and peaking around 9pm — fully lined bar, every booth sat, couple of Mezz tables. Flow slowed around 10pm and went quietly into last-call; everyone out by 12:15am. No late-night pop tonight, which has been unusual for Thursdays lately. Competing events: Knicks vs Hawks Game 3 at State Farm Arena and NFL Draft Round 1 on TV. Bar team did solid table service and pushed for reviews during positive interactions. Missed target by ≁36% ($1,891 vs $2,965). Comps just 1.4%. Food $219. 86: Fernet Branca, Herradura Blanco, Ocho Repo. MOD: MKZ // JK Key.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: Another event-driven night: Visit Music City private event pushed sales — feedback strong, crew killed it. Aside from the event, steady night with premium party people and a ~7pm pop that JO and Brandon snapped into boss mode to serve quickly. Beat target essentially on the nose (+0.1%, $4,885 vs $4,880), though event sales may be booked separately on TripleSeat depending on structure — typeform counts total net $4,885. Comps just 0.18% ($9). Low food sales ($80) as expected for an event-heavy night. 86: Lairds, Ritual NA Gin, backup Campari, GF Pockets, Chopped Salad. MOD: MD & JR/TY.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: Strong Thursday that felt like a weekend night. DC/AM $834.92, D&C PM $9,970.64, Garden/6A $2,290.46. Kitchen busy, bar full, 6A cranking. Hosted Attentive Team Day 3 in Vauxhall (20 guests, 8am-5pm, to-go breakfast + buffet lunch): event food $1,482, event bev $247, total event F&B $1,729. Total incl. events: $12,534.56. Beat target by +14% ($10,805.56 vs $9,491.15 non-event). Comps 5.3% ($572.95) — mostly employee half-off. Guests 270. Break make-up not completed tonight. Evening MOD: Michael Buonocore; Chef: Maggie.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: Half-full but exuberant open — hit $1K by 6:50pm despite only half the tables open, thanks to strong food orders and roundbuilding. Powerful second turn, a lull, then an ok pop around 11pm. 157 covers, 4 large parties, 5 solos (unusually low), ~11 investor cocktails. Food $820, bev $4,964. Top sellers: Material Control, Thunderball, Masari. Missed target by −8.6% ($5,784 vs $6,331). Comps 3.6% ($209.10) — investor and member heavy night. Three Tock reservation glitches (Kruger, McCarthy, Knox) — Tock fix still outstanding. No incidents, no no-shows. MOD: Courtney & Alejandro.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: Wonky pace — never fully filled, lots of small rushes and a few campers. Seated the whole room with 2 servers and cut a bartender around 10pm; slowed, then gradually filled back up. Lots of 4-tops. Complaint about the smell again (less severe than yesterday) — moved the group and comped dessert, kept them happy and taking photos. Phased out Bailey at last call. Marquee $5,416, Standing Room $0, Food $790. Missed target by ≁26% ($5,416 vs $7,339). Comps $245 (couple late-rung items, DNLs, investors, birthdays). Favorite: London visitors geeking out at a Waymo. Maintenance: urinal unclogged (✓); smell still present — incense + water down drains continuing. MOD: Gigi & Chef Selenia.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: Opened to the public at 9pm after a private event + cocktail class (event sales $5,320 — total incl. events $7,692). 9-10:30pm reservations mostly no-showed but a decent steady stream of walk-ins filled in. Never at full capacity but a few large tables carried energy; transitioned to one well and cut a server before last call; room empty by 1am. Food $239 (≁10% of sales). D&C non-event total $2,372 vs target $5,848 (−59.4%) — incl. events $7,692 vs target $5,848 = +31.5%. Comps only $14 (Voids $38). Guests 54 (49 walk-ins, 5 resos — 20 of which were cocktail class). Maintenance: 2nd bathroom, water heaters. Highlight: head of the private party HR shaking her own daiquiri and chugging it. MOD: Kevin / Cory.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: Steady Thursday across venues but shy of target. MB Morning $1,115 / 26g (strong hotel coffee volume + two new servers in early training), MB Evening $5,373 / 140g (decent start but light on floor walk-ins; bar full through early dinner, dying down after 8pm). Sun Club $358 — opened without pool-attendant coverage but Sofia stepped in and held it down; Kelwin helped with close. Hot Eye $927 — sleepy feeling all day, SCAD groups + small industry pop around 11pm, productive prep during lulls. Kitchen smooth, no 86s, no send-backs. Food $2,771. Missed target by ≁29% ($7,774 vs $11,000). Comps 4.1%. Highlights: Catie's family celebration camped out most of the night; ATL out-of-towners returning tomorrow for dinner. Evening MOD: Justin & Sukru. Entered by Alexis.
